generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Valid KPWD Class IV Civil License & above
Valid License obtained with the Labour Department to be enclosed
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderer should have Provided Valid copy of Group Insurance policy for Labors /employees.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, No. 2 Building Division, Bangalore during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the Standard tender document Attached. Ongoing works list/commitments self attested to be uploaded.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour laws and minimum wages act

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder

If the Successful Bidder has quoted lesser rates than the estimated rates then he should remit the Unbalanced Tender Amount along with the Security Deposit within the stipulated time as that shall be specified in the Letter of Acceptance, failing which the tender of the Successful Bidder shall be rejected
Terms and condition of Contract as per Approved Standard Tender Document KW-1/2/3.
The quoted rates by the bidder shall be EXCLUDING GST
Valid E.P.F. Registration Certificate and Challans for past 03 months.
Valid E.S.I. Registration Certificate and Challans for past 03 months.
Valid G.S.T. Registration Certificate
Valid Professional Tax Registration Certificate.
Tenderer Shall note, that the tenderers those found eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers(ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation

Bidder Should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-2 Tender condition, the statements showing the value of existing commitment and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or Equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1

The labour wage rates have been adopted in accordance with Karnataka Government Notification No. Labour Department 411 LDWA 2023 dated:22.05.2026. In respect to these rates, Writ Petition No. WP-16145/2026 is pending before the Honble High Court of Karnataka at Bengaluru. Therefore, the said rates are subject to the final judgment/order of the honorable Court.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

3.2To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26(a)achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs 21.12 Lakhs
